general.name: Bhuiyan Group
general.vision: To be the premier diversified industrial and engineering conglomerate in Bangladesh, delivering sustainable power, clean water, renewable energy, and world-class products that drive national economic self-reliance.
general.mission: Empower industries and communities across Bangladesh through relentless engineering excellence, turnkey power generation, green energy adoption, resilient electro-mechanical infrastructure, and high-standard consumer products.
general.overview: Established as a cornerstone of Bangladeshi industrial growth, Bhuiyan Group (BG) operates across five strategic sectors: heavy power generation, renewable solar technology, electro-mechanical substation engineering, industrial water pump systems, and certified infant care essentials. With an established footprint across Dhaka, Chittagong, and major industrial hubs, Bhuiyan Group combines deep engineering expertise with steadfast corporate integrity.

coreSectorsSection.headline: Our Core Business Sectors
coreSectorsSection.description: Comprehensive engineering solutions across power generation, clean energy, and industrial systems.

sectors.title: Heavy Power Generation & Diesel Generators
sectors.description: Industrial standby, prime, and continuous power generation systems powered by Perkins, Cummins, and Baudouin engines for industrial factories, export zones, and commercial complexes.

sectors.title: Rooftop Solar & Renewable Clean Energy
sectors.description: Turnkey commercial & industrial (C&I) solar photovoltaic systems, net-metering integration, solar water pumps, and utility-grade solar EPC solutions accelerating Bangladesh's green energy transition.

sectors.title: Industrial Water Pumps & Hydrant Infrastructure
sectors.description: High-performance centrifugal pumps, deep tube-well installations, industrial dewatering, wastewater handling, and NFPA-compliant fire-fighting pump systems.

sectors.title: Electro-Mechanical & Substation Engineering
sectors.description: Design, manufacturing, and commissioning of 11kV/33kV substations, HT/LT switchgear panels, PFI plants, dry & oil-type transformers, and automated synchronizing systems.

sectors.title: Certified Mother & Infant Essentials
sectors.description: Import, distribution, and retail of medical-grade baby feeding, sterile mother care accessories, infant nutrition hygiene, and developmental nursery products.
